The model

Small gains multiply.

Four numbers set how fast new revenue comes in. They multiply, so get each one a little better and the total moves a lot. Try it.

New revenue a month

+48%

Four numbers, a little better each. No new hires, no new market.

1.10 × 1.10 × 1.10 × 1.11 = 1.48×

Deals created × win rate × deal size ÷ time to close: the rate new revenue flows out of your pipeline. A shorter cycle means the same deals land sooner, and your team has room for more.

Then keep them. Above 100% net retention, every year starts with more. That's the fifth lever.
